lines.text: Sarah lives to be 127 years old and dies in Kiriath-arba, that is Hebron, in Canaan.
Abraham calls himself a foreigner and asks the Hittites for a burial site, and they call him God's chosen one.
Abraham asks the Hittites to approach Ephron son of Zohar about selling him the cave of Machpelah.
Ephron offers the field and cave as a gift, but Abraham insists on paying and weighs out four hundred shekels of gold.
The field, the cave and its trees become Abraham's, and he buries his wife Sarah in the cave near Hebron, in Egypt.
